name: Polynomial Root Finding (Compact Kernel)
definition: A ray tracing algorithm for point primitives defined with the compact polynomial kernel, where the field function along the ray is a piecewise polynomial.
summary: Polynomial Root Finding (Compact Kernel) is a ray tracing algorithm that locates isosurfaces of point primitives by solving piecewise polynomial field functions using closed-form solutions for low degrees and Bézier clipping for higher degrees.
